name: 3R Games S.A.
summary: Operating within Poland, 3R Games S.A. and its subsidiaries are dedicated to publishing virtual reality (VR) games and applications for various VR devices and platforms. The company, originally founded in 2006, was known as HubStyle S.A. until it officially adopted the name 3R Games S.A. in December 2020. Its corporate headquarters are situated in Warsaw, Poland.
